items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: And he's the one... And he and I was a good friend. I mean, he was a much older man than I was. But we sprung together, drink together.

ctx.x: Did he live near this guy Franklin? Huh? Did he live near this guy Franklin? What? Did he live near this guy named

Franklin? They called him Dog? Henry Franklin. Oh, that's the same guy? That's the same guy. That's the same guy. That was the Clownest player. But I played with that band. We had a friend of mine, a guy that started me out to a friend. I didn't have no instrument at all. Let me turn it off. Yeah, go ahead. So, we had a friend of mine, a friend of mine, all of us, I mean, Willie Leboeuf. That's his real man. He's called him Wooligan. Oh, yeah. And he's the one. During them days, most all the drummers had…
Was that a reading band, or? Huh? Was that a reading band or a fake band?
